data.title: BioVie Announces Topline Results from Phase 2 ADDRESS‑LC Trial Evaluating Bezisterim for the Treatment of Neurological Symptoms Associated with Long COVID
data.description: Bezisterim treatment showed notable benefits in Long COVID patients with substantial reductions in fatigue, cognitive impairment, and post-exertional malaise in specific subgroups. These positive effects were observed in patients with high baseline levels of these symptoms, indicating significant improvements in their conditions.

data.title: New Flyer awarded contract for up to 45 Xcelsior® CNG articulated buses from Central Ohio Transit Authority
data.description: On September 15, 2026, in St. Cloud, Minnesota, NFI Group Inc. (NFI), a prominent bus and motorcoach manufacturer, along with its subsidiary New Flyer of America Inc. (New Flyer), disclosed the acquisition of a contract from the Central Ohio Transit Authority (COTA). This contract pertains to the delivery of a maximum of 45 sixty-foot Xcelsior ® compressed natural gas (CNG) heavy-duty transit buses, equivalent to 90 units. The company's stocks are listed as (TSX: NFI, OTC: NFYEF, TSX: NFI.DB).

data.title: ZenaTech Closes 29th Drone as a Service Acquisition Adding Solar and Railroad Customers with Georgia-based U.S. Land Surveying Company Holding Licenses in 17 States
data.description: In Vancouver, British Columbia, on September 15, 2026, technology solutions provider ZenaTech, Inc. (Nasdaq: ZENA) (FSE: 49Q) (BMV: ZENA) announced the successful acquisition of Merritt Paul Land Surveying, LLC, a Franklin, Georgia-based land surveying firm. Merritt Paul, established in 2015, is known for its surveying services in the solar, transportation, and construction sectors, with notable projects for a leading national transportation firm and a focus on utility-scale solar surveys nationwide. The company holds licenses for land surveys in 17 states. This acquisition represents ZenaTech's 29th acquisition in the Drone as a Service sector.

data.title: Knight Therapeutics Announces Regulatory Submission of GEMTESA® in Canada
data.description: Montreal, September 15, 2026 - Knight Therapeutics Inc. ("Knight") (TSX: GUD), a leading pan-American (ex-US) pharmaceutical company, revealed today that Health Canada has approved Knight's New Drug Submission (NDS) for GEMTESA ® (vibegron). This medication is intended for treating overactive bladder (OAB) in adults, addressing symptoms like urge urinary incontinence, urgency, and urinary frequency. For adult males undergoing pharmacological therapy for benign prostatic hyperplasia (BPH), GEMTESA ® is also proposed to manage OAB with symptoms of urge urinary incontinence, urgency, urinary frequency, and nocturia. This development marks a significant milestone for Knight in the pharmaceutical sector.

data.description: A recent report reveals that the global carbon dioxide emissions have reached record levels in 2021, totaling over 34.5 billion metric tons. This marks a 6% increase compared to 2020 and the highest rise in emissions since 2010. The main contributors to this surge were China and the United States, with emissions increasing by 4.9% and 7.1% respectively. The data highlights the urgent need for more aggressive climate action to curb greenhouse gas emissions and combat the escalating threat of climate change.

data.title: Driven Brands Announces Updated Capital Allocation Priorities
data.description: In Charlotte, North Carolina, Driven Brands Holdings Inc. (NASDAQ: DRVN) disclosed new capital allocation priorities to boost growth and enhance shareholder returns. The company has successfully brought down its net leverage from 5.0x in 2023 to an anticipated 3.0x by the end of Q3 2026, meeting the 3.0x goal a quarter earlier than expected. The commitment to the Growth and Cash framework has proven fruitful, showcasing the company's financial resilience and strategic planning.

data.title: Philadelphia Turns Up the Heat with its First-Ever Sweet Heat Cream Cheese in the United States in Partnership with Mike's Hot Honey®
data.description: Philadelphia and Chicago have partnered to introduce a new product, Philadelphia Mike’s Hot Honey Whipped Cream Cheese, as temperatures drop. This collaboration combines the iconic sweet heat of America's leading hot honey brand, Mike’s Hot Honey, with Philadelphia's whipped cream cheese. The new spread is versatile and can be enjoyed with bagels, charcuterie boards, and even pizza. This product is now available for purchase.

data.title: BX Partners Launches Risk-Aware Bitcoin Model for Financial Advisors
data.description: BX Partners, an investment consulting platform based in Charlotte, North Carolina, has introduced the BX Risk-Aware Bitcoin Model. This new rules-based investment solution is tailored for chief investment officers (CIOs), financial advisors, registered investment advisers (RIAs), and broker-dealers. The model aims to assist in integrating Bitcoin into client portfolios through a disciplined and systematic approach. Accessible via the BX Index platform, this model offers a structured investment process.
